args.title: Bellwether Office: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter: Bellwether Office's latest issue covers "Cold-chain logistics in 2026."
- Article (blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain): Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
- Companion piece (insights.bellwether.example/cold-chain/companion): Pilots cut claims by a quarter.
